content.title: LendingTree CEO Dies in ATV Accident on Family Farm
content.summary: Doug Lebda,  the founder and chief executive of  LendingTree  died Sunday in an all-terrain vehicle accident on his family farm in North Carolina, the company said.  Lebda, who was 55 years old, started the online lending business in 1996 and continued to guide the Charlotte, N.C.-based company amid the booms and busts of the U.S. housing market.  “Our hearts are broken, but we are also deeply grateful for the love and support that has poured in from across the world,” his wife Megan Lebda said in a written statement.
